context:
Goal: every guard or check change gets a stronger second read before it merges.
Problem (rule): the main texts read two ways. A fix check is a short Haiku read of only the fix's diff. Should it follow a FAIL in any round, or only the last round (round 3)?
Based on (read): CLAUDE.md rule roles-review-cap-three: "A small fix to the last round's finding gets a fix check and merges on green." Decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 line 19 says the same (your item 203 a, 2026-11-03 22:24 CST). Rule roles-third-round-steps-up says reviewers run Sonnet from round 2 on.
Based on (measured): lane reviewer-spawn-model (#1280, which changes a check) ran a Haiku fix check after a round-1 FAIL and skipped the Sonnet round 2, as agents/reviewer.md's Fix check paragraph says.
Based on (measured): 5 lanes on Nov 5 ran a Haiku fix check after an early FAIL; each got a Sonnet read before merge (coordinator, 21:18 CST).
Departs from: agents/reviewer.md Fix check paragraph (a fix check after any FAIL) — a: a fix check only after round 3; after a round-1 or round-2 FAIL the next read is a full Sonnet round.

Not blocking: meanwhile the coordinator holds any lane whose fix check followed a round-1 FAIL until it gets a Sonnet round 2. #1280's Sonnet round 2 is running.

lastAnswer.note: Routed 21:33 CST Nov 5 to the coordinator: it lifts the hold on lanes whose fix check followed a round-1 FAIL, and starts lane fix-check-any-round to make rule roles-review-cap-three and decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 say a fix check may follow any round's FAIL. The item closes when that PR merges.

options.gain: Every change gets the Sonnet step-up read before it merges.
options.how: A lane changes agents/reviewer.md's Fix check paragraph to match the rule.
options.label: A fix check only after round 3
options.lose: One more Sonnet review on small round-1 fixes.

options.how: A lane rewrites rule roles-review-cap-three and the decision to match agents/reviewer.md.
options.label: A fix check after any round's FAIL
options.lose: A change can merge on round 1 plus a Haiku diff read, with no Sonnet read.

title: Does a fix check follow a FAIL in any review round, or only round 3?
why: Recommended: a. It matches your rule and the decision text, and keeps the Sonnet read on every guard change.
